`goravel-authz` v1.15.0 targets Goravel 1.15.x. Install it with
`go get github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz@v1.15.0`.

### Added

- Added the Goravel 1.15 release line, installed with `go get github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz@v1.15.0`.
- The same Casbin capabilities as the other lines: adapter batch add and remove, single and batch update, update by filter, filtered loading and transactional rollback.
- The same HTTP middleware, Gate integration, Artisan policy commands and Goravel logging as the other lines.

### Changed

- `package:install` follows the 1.15 conventions: the provider is registered in `config/app.go`, the migration in `database/kernel.go`, and the config, model and migration files are written directly.
- The commands read `ctx.Arguments()`, because the 1.15 console has no `command.Argument`.
- Logging goes through `log.Writer`, because the 1.15 `Log.Channel()` returns a `Writer` rather than a `Log`.
- Requires Goravel framework v1.15.12 and Go 1.24 or newer.

### Notes

- This line has no SQLite integration test: the official `goravel/sqlite` driver requires framework 1.16. The adapter batch, update and filter logic is still covered by the in-memory transactional store.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz/compare/v0.5.0...v1.15.0
